title: Enhancing audio quality for expressive Neural Text-to-Speech
abstract: Highly expressive voices remain challenging for neural Text-to-Speech architectures because of an inherent trade-off between expressiveness and signal quality. We present a set of techniques to enhance the signal quality of a highly expressive voice without additional data: tuning autoregressive loop granularity, integrating Generative Adversarial Networks in acoustic modelling, and deploying Variational Auto-Encoders in both the acoustic model and neural vocoder. Combined, these techniques closed the perceived naturalness gap to human recordings by 39% in MUSHRA evaluations.
